lines.t: This free game once gave away 40 million dollars at a single tournament.
Dota 2 is five against five. Everyone picks one hero, and you win by destroying the enemy's Ancient.
There are more than 125 heroes, and every single one is free.
It began in 2003 as a fan-made map for Warcraft 3. Its lead designer, IceFrog, has stayed anonymous for 20 years.
Its record is 1.29 million players at once, and it still averages over half a million.
Every year the best teams meet at The International, in front of a packed arena.
In 2021 the prize pool passed 40 million dollars, the biggest in esports history. Fans funded it by buying the battle pass.
This August, Team Spirit became the first team to win it three times.
In 2019 an AI called OpenAI Five beat the world champions two games to zero.
It had trained by playing against itself for the equivalent of 45,000 years.

sc.sub: then it won 99.4% of its public games

lines.t: A song about playing it even became a top ten hit in Sweden.
And the giant boss, Roshan, is reportedly named after a bowling ball.
